name: Khimki Witches
overview: The con artists Marina, Sveta and Olya successfully pose as mediums until they accidentally receive a real gift from a street witch. Now Marina can hear thoughts, Sveta can see the future, and Olya can see the dead. New abilities turn girls' lives into hell, so the friends decide to find someone who will take these "gifts" for themselves. In search of the perfect candidate, the girls meet an insidious sorcerer-tempter.
